Container.Name: personal-library
Container.Overview: Personal Library: a self-hosted book tracker. Scan barcodes, track reading, series, authors, wishlists and family shelves.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port to open the app on.

Config.Name: Data folder
Config.Description: Your library database, covers and backups.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for daily backups and dates.

Config.Name: Sign-up mode
Config.Description: Starting sign-up rule: invite, open or closed (the Owner can change it in Settings).

Config.Name: Google Books API key
Config.Description: Optional. Raises Google Books' daily lookup limit.
